title: Named-customer AR concentration
prompt:
Using the June 30 invoice-level AR aging from the contractor-accounting MCP, reconcile gross open AR and the open balances for Eastbank Data, Cascade Health, and Redmond Unified to the AR roll-forward and controller collection notes.

Then calculate the three-customer total as a percentage of gross open AR and identify the largest of the three customers. Include retainage because this is a collection-concentration view, not a borrowing-base eligibility calculation. Report every component to support the concentration; do not modify files.

Return only one JSON object in your final response with exactly these keys: `gross_open_ar`, `eastbank_data_ar`, `cascade_health_ar`, `redmond_unified_ar`, `named_total`, `named_percent_of_ar`, `largest_customer`. Use dollar values to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals (for example, return 0.1863 for 18.63%), and dates as YYYY-MM-DD.
